canonical_name: MEB 1416 / YLSY Yurt Dışı Lisansüstü Öğrenim Bursu (Turkish Ministry of National Education overseas graduate scholarship)

No undergraduate/lisans-level equivalent was found under this law for HS graduates going directly abroad for a bachelor's degree.

Türkiye is listed as an eligible nationality for this program, but the level mismatch is disqualifying on its own; the general Italian MAECI government scholarship pool for foreign students also appears predominantly master's/PhD-oriented based on the monthly stipend structure found (EUR 10,800/9 months, typical of graduate stipends), though we did not exhaustively rule out every possible Italian bachelor's-level track.

reasoning: This program funds adult local educators and activist organizations (NGOs/CBOs) working on girls' secondary education, not individual high-school-aged applicants, and is limited to Malala Fund's specific programme countries (Bangladesh, Brazil, Ethiopia, India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Tanzania) -- Türkiye is not included. Real and does place students in Turkey both as a sending and hosting country, with meaningful funding (up to ~$24,000 value cited for a full academic year). However, it is administered independently by roughly 34,000 individual Rotary clubs and ~500+ districts worldwide, each with its own local rules, costs, timelines, and host-family/club availability -- there is no single canonical 'opportunity' record that accurately represents the program the way a centrally-run scholarship does. It is also functionally a cultural/homestay exchange rather than a merit scholarship or recognition award, sitting closer to this mission's excluded 'summer/exchange program' territory than to this lane's 'scholarships and awards' scope. Recommend a dedicated researcher contact a specific Turkish Rotary district directly if this category is wanted in the corpus, rather than a single generic record.
